notes.title: 5.9 bug fix
notes.content:
1. Reduced the difficulty of starting the endless mode of each map
2. In order to improve game performance, bullets far enough away from the screen will be destroyed. For bullets with a gyration mechanism, the gyration will be triggered immediately
3. Remove the devil bait and overload chip from the item extraction pool of the "abnormal robot" horn bully
4. In endless mode, the upper limit of signal broadcast superposition is adjusted from infinite to 12 times, so as to avoid the attack range of scythe and rocket cat beyond the screen
5. For the golden artifact of the high-pressure champagne gun, the problem that the bonus of gold coins to the size is calculated incorrectly has been fixed.
6. Fixed the problem that the game could not continue normally when the keyboard and mouse were operated at the same time
7. Fixed the problem that in the endless mode, the settlement reward did not get the bonus of gold coins such as the right to enter the dangerous land. In addition, the survival time in endless mode and the settlement reward for killing the boss are doubled
8. Fixed the problem that some curses were invalid
9. Fixed the problem of wrong calculation of contract money
10. Fixed the problem that when you have the blessing of anti-injury, you will be instantly killed by meteorites
11. Fixed the problem that the lower limit of deceleration of Chiho Lili's third skill was invalid. If she already has a certain deceleration, she will not be decelerated when she pushes the enemy
12. Fixed the problem that the magic barrier caused monsters not to appear in some cases
13. Fixed the problem that the airdrops dropped by Mechatron could not be picked up
14. Fixed the problem that the model does not disappear after the death of elite monsters in the asteroid base
15. Fixed the problem that the effect of some recipe wine in endless mode would not disappear
16. Fixed the problem that some items in the store could not be purchased
17. Fixed the problem that the gold coin explosion blessing may crash
18. Fixed the problem that you cannot reconnect after having the black hole blessing
19. Fixed the problem that the special effects of the follower Black Cat and Abyss Siren might not disappear after releasing their skills in Endless Mode

notes.title: 4.30 Update Instruction
notes.content: Thank you for your attention and support for "Return to the Abyss". The following are the main contents of this update: [b]Endless mode[/b] After clearing the Nightmare difficulty of the level, the Endless Mode of the level will be unlocked. In this mode, enemies will come at you in a steady stream, and will become stronger and stronger as time goes on. Defeating bosses and powerful enemies will give you a chance to breathe, buy supplies in the tavern support store and Rich's mobile shop, and get ready to fight stronger enemies. At the same time, the limit on the number of accessories for weapons will no longer exist. After upgrading weapons to artifacts, you can continue to strengthen your weapons! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43140214/ce63f0cf1099359744fea6288a61323ee00e8f93.jpg[/img] [b]legend accessories[/b] The powerful accessories forged by the "God of Manufacturing" Yuti himself have been reproduced in the world. Added 8 new legendary accessories, which either have powerful effects or can change the attack mode of the weapon. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43140214/cdc283ad7c1c9499d56b6d92847e801357fbd0fc.jpg[/img] [b]New blessing effect[/b] The demigods showered more blessings on their worshipers. Added 8 different blessing effects, which will help you. new skin -"Swamp Investigator" Aurora [b]new follower[/b] "Reconnaissance Auxiliary Machine" Dopp After the master died in battle, a smart and unknowing investigation auxiliary machine was born, and came here by accident. Dopp hoped to find someone who could fight alongside it, as it had before. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43140214/3c028f5ba063b4233d6671d830b8271b857ab706.jpg[/img] [b]new props[/b] Automatic Drilling Unit [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43140214/487c74879666872b920ca8d2118ab51c877b2328.jpg[/img] In order to thank you for your support, we will add a free DLC later, please look forward to it

notes.title: About frequently asked questions
notes.content:
- About updates
Updates are in the works, and the next one should be before the Chinese Spring Festival, but due to the tight schedule, it is not yet sure how many contents can be added. The goal is to add new characters, maps and systems. The follow-up update plan is an update with more content every 4-6 weeks, each time including new weapons, characters, maps, etc. And these updates are all free.

-About the task system
The task system is designed to be updated daily, but lots of you is saying that such a design is very uncomfortable, so we are redesigning it to make it refresh in real time, and will upload it as soon as possible after completion.

-About Caton/Crash
We got reported that the game always freezes and crash. We have also paid attention to this bug and are currently investigating it. Due to the large number of different hardwares, we have not yet found the reason, we will definitely fix it and upload it asap.

-about moving in a certain direction
It has been confirmed that it is caused by a conflict between a virtual joystick driver and the game engine, it has been fixed now. please update to latest version.

Please trust that we'll fix all the problems and add more content as soon as possible
